## What to build

Expand the stock shelf (SPEC §42: event, note, person, post) into an interconnected standard library — 'the stock graph'. THE CONTRACT IS THE WORKING SPEC at `.adlc/specs/49-stock-graph.md` (read it first; its 11 acceptance criteria are the rail list, each naming its test file). Design settled with Myk in chat 2026-08-25, then amended the same day by the independent premortem at `.adlc/specs/49-stock-graph.premortem.md`. Three amendments await Myk's re-approval and are flagged in the spec: story 1's install set (shallow-person, not person), the thread split into three per-lens entries, and ShallowReference dropped.

## The shape of the design (details in the working spec)

1. TWO-LAYER CATALOG. Base layer: flat entityGatherJson programs, writable, no expands — the four existing entries keep their gather bodies BYTE-IDENTICAL and grow schema props only, so old data survives and no §20 migration is needed. Graph layer: programs that expand — org, message, task, document, shallow-person, shallow-org, person-graph, post-thread, message-thread.
2. ONE ENTRY PROVIDES ONE LENS; the CLI name is the kebab-case of the lens name. PostThread and MessageThread are separate programs over the same anchor entities.
3. TERMINATION IS A DAG derived from the bytes: the reading-reference graph (entry → readings its body's expands name) must be acyclic, flat bases and shallow readings as sinks. Railed. `fix` stays off the shelf.
4. DEPENDENCIES ARE DERIVED by walking bodies, never declared; shelf closure railed; the closure test carries a hand-written per-entry table so a walk bug cannot go vacuously green (H10).
5. TRANSITIVE INSTALL, sinks first, each registration the same verbatim-file path (§42.1 invariant). SKIP-IF-BOUND KEYS ON THE LENS NAME (lensOf, never the program name — H6); the rail fixture must bind a lens whose program name differs.
6. DIVERGENCE COMPOSES AND WARNS AT BOTH LAYERS (Myk): stock-identity = schema snapshot hash AND hyperschema gather body both match (versionedSchemaHash covers props+default only). Never refuse; exit 0.
7. RE-RUN IS EVOLVE-WITH-REPORT (Myk), including the qualified does-not-bind outcome. The upgrade rail starts from a §42-era fixture store.
8. PROP LISTS ARE PINNED (Myk — reverses §42.5): a rail asserts every entry's exact prop list and edge-reading assignment. No entry carries author/from/creator/sender — the signer is the identity.
9. replyTo AND thread are orthogonal (In-Reply-To vs References). MODERATION STRIKES THE MEMBERSHIP POINTER at the anchor; the husk case (body struck, membership alive) is pinned as documented behavior.
10. Thread-vs-collection (member-signed vs curator-signed) is TEACHING, not a bytes guarantee — stated with §42.2's exits.
11. BUILD AS A STACK of small PRs: machinery first (dependency walk, DAG+closure rails, transitive install, lens-keyed skip-if-bound, two-layer divergence warning, pin rail), then shapes sinks-first.

## User stories

Five, in the working spec — approved by Myk 2026-08-25, story 1 amended post-premortem (flagged for his re-approval).

## Acceptance criteria

The working spec's 11 criteria, verbatim. New rails: test/cli/stock-graph.test.ts, stock-deps.test.ts, stock-install.test.ts, stock-upgrade.test.ts, stock-depth.test.ts, stock-thread.test.ts, stock-federation.test.ts, stock-pin.test.ts. Frozen rails test/cli/stock.test.ts and test/cli/pack-stock.test.ts (T85) stay untouched; every new shelf entry must satisfy their per-entry invariants (non-empty props and writable).

## Constraints

- rhizomatic is frozen. Expands-with-readings and the JSON term dialect exist since 0.8. If a substrate need appears, stop and surface it.
- §42.1 invariant: every entry stays a verbatim `loam register` file through the shared validator. No privileged path.
- Landing writes spec/49-stock-graph.md with provenance, amends §42.5's editorial-content paragraph, archives this ticket, and adds a capabilities-book chapter claim (test/site/capabilities.test.ts).
- Rails are declared at P3 when the test files exist, not before.
- Implementation starts only after Myk re-approves the three flagged amendments (P1 stop).
title: The stock graph — expand the shelf into an interconnected standard library with derived dependencies and transitive install
